'''R3-M3'''<ref name="toy">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Legacy Collection|packtype=Build-A-Droid|pack=R3-M3|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TLCBADR3M3.asp}}</ref> was an [[R3-series astromech droid/Legends|R3-series]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]]<ref name="ANH" /> which was manufactured by [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]].<ref name="SWE" /> A [[Color/Legends|blue]]-plated [[Droid/Legends|droid]],<ref name="ANH" /> R3-M3 had a clear [[Plastex/Legends|plastex]] dome that exposed its computer processors.<ref name="BTM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref> By [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> R3-M3 served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and was present aboard the Imperial [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]].<ref name="ANH" /> In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="NEC" /> R3-M3 was rolling through a corridor in the [[Space station/Legends|station]] when the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] snuck across the corridor behind the droid in order to deactivate the battlestation's [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]]. Shortly after, during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] destroyed the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] in the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]].<ref name="ANH" />

==Behind the scenes==
R3-M3 first appeared in [[1977]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], the first film of the [[original trilogy]].<ref name="ANH" /> The droid's scene was filmed between [[June 2]] and [[June 16]], [[1976]] at [[Elstree Studios]]'s Stage 2.<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars]]''</ref> In [[January]] [[2009]],<ref name="Insider">{{SWArchive|url=fans/media/news20090113.html|text=Classic Gold in ''Star Wars Insider'' #107}}</ref> "[[Toy Wars]]," an article [[Jason Fry]] wrote for the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine's [[Star Wars Insider 107|107th issue]], first named the droid as R3-O1.<ref name="Toy Wars">{{InsiderCite|107|Toy Wars}}</ref> For unknown reasons, however, the droid's name was changed to R3-M3 for a Build-A-Droid action figure made for [[Hasbro]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Legacy Collection]]'' toy line<ref name="toy" /> in [[October]] of that year.<ref name="Jedi Business">{{WebCite|url=https://www.jeditemplearchives.com/legacy2/evg/R3-M3-Build-A-Droid-Legacy-Collection.html|text=R3-M3 (Hasbro - Legacy Collection Build A Droid Series) - JediTempleArchives.com|work=[https://www.jeditemplearchives.com JediTempleArchives.com]|archivedate=20130912235046}}</ref>
